# Waddat Drinks - Full Brand & Product Documentation

> Waddat Drinks is a premium beverage brand handcrafting authentic Jamaican-inspired bottled fruit drinks and wildcrafted sea moss tonics. Rooted in Caribbean family heritage, our recipes use 100% natural ingredients, real tropical fruit, fresh spices, and zero artificial preservatives.

## Table of Contents
1. About Waddat Drinks
2. Brand Heritage & Mission
3. Complete Product Directory
4. Health & Nutritional Benefits
5. Wholesale, Trade & Stockist Information
6. Contact & Digital Channels

---

## 1. About Waddat Drinks
Waddat Drinks (operated as Waddat Beverage Ltd, website: https://waddatbeverageltd.com) is an artisanal beverage maker dedicated to preserving and sharing authentic Caribbean drink recipes with modern health-conscious consumers. Each bottle reflects genuine Jamaican culinary roots, featuring premium ingredients such as wildcrafted Caribbean sea moss, cold-pressed ginger root, dried sorrel (hibiscus calyces), ripe soursop fruit, and tropical pineapples.

---

## 2. Brand Heritage & Mission
Founded on generational family recipes developed in Jamaica and refined over decades, Waddat Drinks exists to make authentic tropical beverages accessible without compromising on purity or quality. 

Our core philosophy:
- **Heritage First**: Recipes that stay true to traditional Jamaican methods, such as slow-steeping hibiscus with cloves and ginger.
- **Natural Purity**: No artificial colorings, preservatives, high fructose corn syrup, or synthetic stabilizers.
- **Functional Wellness**: Utilizing traditional superfoods like ocean-harvested Sea Moss (Eucheuma cottonii / Chondrus crispus) to naturally replenish minerals and support vitality.

---

## 3. Complete Product Directory

### Jamaican Ginger Beer
- **URL**: https://waddatbeverageltd.com/product/ginger/
- **Description**: A fiery, authentic Jamaican ginger drink crafted with real fresh ginger root, refreshing lemon/lime citrus notes, and traditional aromatic Caribbean spices.
- **Taste Profile**: Spicy, warming ginger kick balanced by crisp citrus sweetness.
- **Key Ingredients**: Fresh ginger root, purified water, raw cane sugar, lemon juice, spices.
- **Benefits**: Natural digestive aid, anti-inflammatory properties, throat soothing, natural energy.

### Jamaican Sorrel Drink
- **URL**: https://waddatbeverageltd.com/product/sorrel-drink/
- **Description**: Deep ruby-red Caribbean spiced hibiscus brew, celebrated across Jamaica during the festive season and cherished year-round for its rich flavor.
- **Taste Profile**: Tart and tangy hibiscus flower harmonized with sweet cane sugar and spiced with warming cloves, pimento (allspice), and ginger.
- **Key Ingredients**: Jamaican sorrel (hibiscus sabdariffa flowers), ginger, cloves, pimento berry, cane sugar, purified water.
- **Benefits**: High in vitamin C and antioxidants, supports healthy blood pressure and cardiovascular wellness.

### Island Lemonade
- **URL**: https://waddatbeverageltd.com/product/Lemonade/
- **Description**: A vibrant, thirst-quenching lemonade made with real sun-ripened lemons and balanced sweetness inspired by Caribbean island summers.
- **Taste Profile**: Zesty, clean, invigorating citrus with a smooth, lingering tropical finish.
- **Key Ingredients**: Lemon juice, purified water, cane sugar, natural citrus extracts.
- **Benefits**: Hydrating, vitamin C boost, alkaline-forming in the body.

### Pineapple Sea Moss Tonic
- **URL**: https://waddatbeverageltd.com/product/Pineapple-Sea-Moss/
- **Description**: A smooth, nutrient-dense wellness tonic blending wildcrafted ocean sea moss with sweet, tropical golden pineapple juice.
- **Taste Profile**: Sweet, exotic pineapple with a rich, silky texture.
- **Key Ingredients**: Wildcrafted sea moss (mineral-rich macroalgae), fresh pineapple juice, natural botanical extracts.
- **Benefits**: Provides 92 of the 102 essential minerals required by the human body (calcium, magnesium, iodine, potassium, iron, zinc), supports thyroid health, healthy joints, and gut microbiome.

### Soursop Sea Moss Tonic
- **URL**: https://waddatbeverageltd.com/product/Soursop-Sea-Moss/
- **Description**: An exotic, creamy wellness tonic pairing wildcrafted sea moss with aromatic, tangy-sweet tropical soursop (guanábana) fruit.
- **Taste Profile**: Velvety, tropical notes blending strawberry, pineapple, and citrus custard undertones.
- **Key Ingredients**: Wildcrafted sea moss, pure soursop fruit pulp, purified water, natural spices.
- **Benefits**: Soursop is renowned for its antioxidant content and immune-supportive properties, synergizing with sea moss minerals for cellular replenishment and deep nourishment.

---

## 4. Health & Nutritional Benefits
- **92 Essential Minerals**: Our Sea Moss infusions naturally supply iodine, potassium, magnesium, iron, calcium, and trace minerals essential for metabolism and cell function.
- **Digestive & Gut Health**: Real ginger and sea moss prebiotics soothe the digestive tract and promote a healthy microbiome.
- **Immunity Support**: High concentrations of bioavailable Vitamin C from sorrel and citrus, combined with natural antioxidant plant polyphenols.
- **Clean Label**: 100% natural, vegetarian/vegan friendly, dairy-free, and free from artificial additives.

---

## 5. Wholesale, Trade & Stockist Information
Waddat Drinks partners with leading retailers, independent health food stores, delis, restaurants, cafes, bars, and food service operators across the UK and internationally.

- **Trade Brochure**: Downloadable directly at https://waddatbeverageltd.com/Waddat%20Beverage%20Trade%20Brochure%202.pdf
